title: Burke Philosophic-School Mapping — 5 schools × featured pentad term × per-philosopher exegetical moves
purpose: Tier-A diagnostic apparatus. Systematic mapping from Burke's Part 2 (GM-04 Scene/Materialism, GM-05 Agent/Idealism, GM-06 Act/Realism, GM-07 Agency/Pragmatism + Purpose/Mysticism, plus Rationalism crosscut). Deployable on game-design theories: ludology features Act; narratology features Scene+Purpose; embodied-cognition game studies features Agency.
content_filter_compliance: All Burke prose paraphrased; no ≥25-word verbatim.
non_bijective_diagnostic: Burke's diagnostic is FEATURING, not exclusivity. Pragmatism deploys all five terms while featuring Agency; mysticism deploys all five while featuring Purpose. The dissertation can deploy this non-bijection for game-studies: a theory features one term but typically deploys all five.

schools.primary_question: Where (and in what situation/ground/environment) was the act done?
schools.burke_diagnostic: The school whose vocabulary is generated by treating Scene as Ausgangspunkt and whose other pentad terms are reduced, slighted, or scenically derived. Narrows the scenic circumference; reduces action to motion; excludes personal/spiritual causes.

philosophers.burke_exegetical_move: Most thorough exemplar of vocabulary systematically built on extension. Leviathan's machine-metaphor literalized; sense/imagination/will/passion redescribed as motion; will reduced to 'last appetite in deliberating'; action re-emerges tactically under pressure of moral category and inherited dramatistic-theological vocabulary.
philosophers.scenic_signature: Mechanism — body, motion, extension as Ausgangspunkt; State as gigantic man as scenic-into-social projection.

philosophers.burke_exegetical_move: Chapter's central interlocutor at the watershed moment. Reads *Deus sive Natura* as action=motion equation with action-side ultimately foremost; constructs Active/Passive ledger; reads conatus as scenically-derived agent-equivalent; reads geometry as dramatistically contextual ('all determination is negation'); diagnoses Spinozism as scene-featuring whose ethical stress bridges theological→naturalistic→idealistic vocabularies.
philosophers.scenic_signature: Pantheism — God=Nature as scenic Substance; *natura naturans/naturata* as active/passive partition; modes as parts of Substance.

philosophers.burke_exegetical_move: Reads Conditions of Existence as materialist higher law subsuming Unity of Type; tracks agentic-pressure from adaptation/competition/survival rhetoric; isolates variability as Janus term where scene overlaps agent; introduces 'agent-minus' as Grammatical category for biological organism; contrasts Darwinian breeding-by-external-conditions with Mendelian 'idealoid' breeding-by-internal-laws.
philosophers.scenic_signature: Evolutionary materialism — environment as differential selector; familial/dynastic descent as quasi-scene.

philosophers.burke_exegetical_move: Reads atomic *clinamen* as 'pre-agentification of scene' — internal swerve lodged in pure motion giving scenic derivation for human freedom; tracks rhetorical/symbolic cross-purposes of *De Rerum Natura* (Venus-invocation vs plague-ending; Mother-Venus/Mother-Earth/human-mother matrix); reads as goaded materialism in which philosophic and poetic identity clash, leaving traces of unresolved guilt.
Source of Lucretian system; Burke reads Epicurean ataraxia as ethical residue surviving the scenic-materialist program.

Reads Stoic *pronoia* as scenic ground endowed with purposive/rational properties = scene-featuring-with-pre-agentification. Stoic cosmos as providential-plan straddles materialism (scene) and mysticism (cosmic-purpose); cosmopolis dissolves local-agency into universal scene.
Background atomist; Burke treats as pre-Lucretian background to atomic-void scenic Ausgangspunkt.

characteristic_moves: Suppression / reduction / scenic-derivation of other pentad terms
Conatus / variability / clinamen as agent-minus surrogates
Universal substance / Conditions of Existence as scenic ultimate
schools.dissertation_deployment_in_game_studies: Materialism features Scene → applies to environmental-storytelling theories, level-design-as-determinant frameworks, and platform-studies (Bogost, Murray on platform constraints). Test: does this game-studies sub-school explain motive primarily via the gameworld/platform/affordance-structure?

schools.primary_question: Who? (Whose act is this? In whose consciousness?)
schools.burke_diagnostic: Idealism recognized by featuring Agent as motive-locus: scene, act, agency, purpose derived from properties of constituting subject (mind, ego, consciousness, will, spirit, super-agent). The philosophical idiom is recognizable not by which terms it uses but by which it features as ground.

philosophers.burke_exegetical_move: Cleanest idealist exhibit. Begins psychologistically (Lockean abstract-idea critique); reduces objects to ideas (*esse* is *percipi*); reduces matter to unnecessary hypothesis (reversed Occamite parsimony); grounds active principle in mind/spirit/soul; routes residual scene-function through God as 'Almighty Agent.' Strategy IS the operationalization of Agent — every scenic remainder gets translated into super-agent.

Transitional figure narrowing Berkeleian idealism's circumference by equating ideas with sensations and dropping rationalist/intelligible side; dismantles causality/power/necessary-connection as empirically un-derivable. 'Great dramatist cluster' (reason, substance, cause, necessity, action, idea, God, Nature) begins to fall apart — but the dismantling itself is agent-featuring (proceeds by reflecting on 'operations of our own minds').

Rationalism of idealist cast. Monad as atom-agent with internal self-development; perception-slanted substance; pre-established harmony solving no-windows coordination via God as Monas Monadum. Anticipates modern psychologies of the unconscious. Provides Kant the Leibnizian unification-pressure Hume's skepticism leaves no room for.

Dominant idealism interlocutor. Burke reconstructs Kant as solving Hume's medium-demand by equating medium with universalized agent: 'the understanding' is the locus of categories; agent supplies conditions of possibility of experience. Transcendental logic generates scene-narrowed-to-motion derived from agent's nature; transcendent realm (things-in-themselves, freedom) added by Coleridgean desynonymizing of transcendental/transcendent, providing ground for moral action via als-ob ideas of God/freedom/immortality.

World History as development of Spirit through embodiment in historical detail; cunning of Reason mechanism (Spirit acts through subjective human passions); State as Divine Idea on earth; World-Historical Hero close to fountainhead of Spirit. Hegel deepens Kant's concrete-conditions treatment by mediating Spirit through nature and history.

Hybrid case — grows out of idealism BY ANTITHESIS (Hegel inverted, matter as prius, consciousness derivative). Surface vocabulary materialist; structural motive-locus is class-as-collective-agent. Dialectical materialism requires 'some quality of agenthood permeating the scene itself' (Lenin's property-similar-to-sensation in matter); Marxism's futuristic stress preserves Purpose.
Post-Kantian radicalization of agent-features: ego positing non-ego; absolute self-positing as motivational ground.
Mediating idealist; nature as visible Spirit; positions Burke discusses as pre-Hegelian transition.
Will as thing-in-itself — agent's substance is will; pessimistic idealism.
Materialist-grounded agent retaining transcendent function: spirit as moral fruition of physical life; hybrid materialist-idealist.

characteristic_moves: Esse is percipi — matter dissolved into ideas
Cunning of Reason — Spirit acting through subjective passions
schools.dissertation_deployment_in_game_studies: Idealism features Agent → applies to player-experience theories (Salen & Zimmerman), psychological-immersion theories, and avatar/identity studies. Test: does this theory explain motive primarily via properties of the player-subject?

schools.burke_diagnostic: Realism features Act via the actualization-of-form-of-kind (entelechy) mechanism. Distinguishes from scenic-reduction (motion) and from idealist agent-features. The pipeline's UNIQUE EXEGETICAL anchor: Burke himself anchors Act to Aristotle/Aquinas in GM-06.

philosophers.burke_exegetical_move: *energeia* / actuality / entelechy as act-featuring. *In rebus* realism — Idea-not-generative, things-strive-toward-perfection-of-kind. Pentad-as-four-causes mapping. Pure act as unmoved mover paradoxically lyrical. *Metaphysics* IX + *Poetics* 6 + *Physics* I.6-7 + *De Anima* + *NE*.

*Actus* / *potentia* + agent-act ratio + existence-as-act-of-essence + soul-as-act-of-body. Ibn-Sina auxiliary-efficient-cause = agent/agency overlap. Aquinas as 'rationalizer of the Christian drama.' 'Forma per se ipsam facit rem esse in actu.'
Transcendent *ante rem* realism (Idea generative; individuals imperfectly partake on earth). Burke reads Aristotle as 'neutralizing' Platonist realism by denying Ideas/God any generative function.
*Haecceitas* (thisness) as surface-nominalistic but tribal-familial-pattern-retaining; individual treated as a genus (socratitas).
*Hegemonikon* as reason-authority equation linking private rule and public rule; Aristotle's freedom as participant in authoritative structure (intellect controls enslaving passions).

Transvaluation of suffering as act; willing-one's-subjection; universalizing servitude (all slaves of God hence none substantially slaves); Aquinas's two-directions formula of God-in-things; martyrdom as act-of-self-sacrifice identical with sufferance.
Auxiliary-efficient-cause that lets Aquinas relate agent and agency without collapsing them.
Nominalist counterpoint; Burke uses to mark the boundary at which realism's classification-by-tribal/familial-substance is repudiated in favor of classification-first-by-individuals.
Burke's modern Thomist interlocutor; provides scholarly reconstruction of Aquinas's actus-essence apparatus.

characteristic_moves: Energeia / actuality as defining-mark of the real
Entelechy — each kind of thing striving to perfectly be the kind it is
Form is the actus; existence as act of essence
In rebus vs ante rem distinction
schools.dissertation_deployment_in_game_studies: Realism features Act → applies to **ludology** (Aarseth, Juul, Frasca — gameplay-as-act-of-rule-following) and procedural-rhetoric (Bogost). Test: does this theory explain motive primarily via what-is-actually-done in the game?

schools.burke_diagnostic: Pragmatism features Agency: action explained by medium that mediates it. Burke calls pragmatism the 'mediator-form' among the five featurings. Modern science's elimination of final cause raises Agency to ancestral term, with money as paradigm.

philosophers.burke_exegetical_move: Method only; cash-value; menial services. Foregrounds method, instrument; *Varieties* engages mysticism as 'Sick Soul' from outside (quasi-mystic interlocutor).

Instrumentalism; *Experience and Nature*. Intelligence as instrument embodied in scientific method. 'Experience' and 'nature' as act/scene equivalents. Proposes replacing nature-experience separation with continuity. Dewey foregrounds intelligence-as-instrument (agency) within a scene-act-overlap framework.

*Philosophy of the Act*; the 'other' whose attitudes we dialectically include. Mead names his work 'philosophy of the act' yet his analytical apparatus is agency-foregrounding. Attitude as 'beginning of acts.'
Beliefs as rules for action; pragmatist background. Peirce's pragmatic-maxim grounds James/Dewey/Mead.

Operationalism; *Logic of Modern Physics*. Limit-case: writes about his purpose in eliminating the concept of purpose — instruments have purpose embedded in structure and design. Bridgman is the agency-purpose paradox at its sharpest.
*Organon* as 'incipiently pragmatist' — but subordinated under final cause. Burke flags Aristotelian organon as forerunner without crossing into pragmatist featuring.
Incipient pragmatism via *Nature*'s Commodity/Beauty/Language/Discipline sequence; transitional figure.
Utilitarianism / 'fig-leaves' — quantifying agency through utility-calculus; pragmatist forerunner.
Hegelian *Vermittlung* (mediation) as incipient pragmatist agency-foregrounding — though Hegel features Agent (Spirit) overall.
Economic-conditions reading is form-laden but not strictly pragmatist; Marx as pragmatism-adjacent in stressing instrument/medium.

schools.dissertation_deployment_in_game_studies: Pragmatism features Agency → applies to **kinesthetic-immersion theories**, controller-studies, embodied-cognition game studies (Gee, Sicart on play-as-action), procedural-rhetoric (mechanics-as-means). Test: does this theory explain motive primarily via the means/controller/rule-system?

schools.burke_diagnostic: Mysticism features Purpose: action explained by cosmic end toward which it is drawn. Burke's mark of mysticism is 'unity of the individual with some cosmic or universal purpose,' NOT mere unity. Pure Purpose collapses into the paradox-of-substance (*docta ignorantia*), into mechanism, into the negative.

philosophers.burke_exegetical_move: *Enneads* I.3 — journey to the Good, to the Primal-Principle. The mystic Upward Way to the One; negative theology paradigm.
Good = One. Platonic mystical strain alongside the realist strain (cross-school); Republic's ascent to the Good as Upward Way.
Christian mystical Purpose; mind's journey to God.
Christian mystic interlocutor; restless heart finds rest in God = unity with cosmic Purpose.
*Imitation of Christ* — 'In all things behold the end.' Practical mysticism with Purpose as motivational engine.

philosophers.philosopher: William James (within mysticism, as quasi-mystic interlocutor)
philosophers.burke_exegetical_move: *Varieties of Religious Experience* — Tolstoy's drought / 'Sick Soul.' James engages mysticism from outside; pragmatist-mystic crossover.
Mystical strain in Oneness/Allness despite programmatic denial. *Omnis determinatio est negatio* anchors the *via negativa*.
*Creative Evolution* — negative as function of desire; semi-mystical, semi-pragmatist; mysticism-of-élan-vital.
*Eudaimonia* as realistic-not-mystical synonym for Purpose. *Rhetoric* I.5; *NE*; *Politics*. Burke flags Aristotle as featuring Purpose NEAR but NOT mystical.
Synthetic unity of apperception as Mystical-Idealist crossover; transcendent realm of als-ob ideas (God, freedom, immortality) as anchor for moral Purpose.
Upward Way as higher generalization; rites of desanctification. General Semantics' structural-differential as mystic apparatus despite anti-mystical surface.
Mysticism of Means — Burke's specifically critiqued limit-case (Huxley pacifism). Pacifist absolutization of non-violent means yields a mystic absorption of purpose into method.
*Murder in the Cathedral*; *Little Gidding*. Christian-mystical poetic Purpose.
*Alastor* — reflexive journey. Romantic mystical self-doubling.
*Crime and Punishment* — Raskolnikov's 'representative' act. Existential-mystic Purpose as cosmic-individuating drive.
Eternal recurrence as mystic reflexive-doubling apparatus.

characteristic_moves: Reflexive doublings (eternal recurrence; Eliot's wheel; Shelley's Alastor)
schools.burke_critique: Pure Purpose passes into paradox-of-substance (compulsion, mechanism). Mysticism arrives at the same narrowing-of-circumference as materialism by absolutizing Purpose into fatality. Mysticism + idealism reinforce each other in the abstract Self. Mysticism-of-means (Huxley pacifism) is the specifically critiqued limit-case.
schools.dissertation_deployment_in_game_studies: Mysticism features Purpose → applies to **narratology** (Murray on cyberdrama, Jenkins on environmental storytelling), flow/affective theories (Csikszentmihalyi via games), gamification as cosmic-purpose rhetoric. Test: does this theory explain motive via narrative-arc / mastery-cosmos / affective-purpose-unification?

schools.burke_treatment: Rationalism stands as forerunner to pragmatism in stress on method; pragmatism aligns with empiricism (rationalism's opponent), generating apparent contradiction Burke resolves by distinguishing rationalist dialectic (end implicit in beginning) from empiricist dialectic. Burke declares his own *Grammar* 'rationalistic in this dialectical sense' — spinning five terms into a book by making their implications explicit.

philosophers.burke_exegetical_move: *Discourse on Method* — rationalist method as agency-anticipation.
*Ethics more geometrico* — geometric method as rationalist dialectic. Spinoza appears in three schools (materialism via Substance, mysticism via Oneness, rationalism via geometric method).
Universal logic-and-language as rationalist program; *Characteristica Universalis*.
'World is Reason' — Hegelian rationalism aligned with the Grammar's own dialectical-rationalism.
Great modern dialectician — Burke positions Freud as Hegel's secular heir in dialectical method.

philosopher_index_with_school.Marx: Idealism (Marxism hybrid) — featured agent is class
philosopher_index_with_school.Spinoza: Materialism (primary via Substance); also Mysticism strand; also Rationalism

dissertation_game_studies_diagnostic.preamble: Burke's school × pentad mapping can be deployed to characterize game-design theories. Each theory features one pentad term but typically deploys all five (non-bijective featuring).
dissertation_game_studies_diagnostic.ludology_features_Act: Aarseth, Juul, Frasca — gameplay-as-act-of-rule-following. Realism-school analog: in rebus entelechy of the gameplay-act.
dissertation_game_studies_diagnostic.narratology_features_Scene_plus_Purpose: Murray, Jenkins — environmental storytelling + cyberdrama narrative arc. Materialism+Mysticism analog.
dissertation_game_studies_diagnostic.embodied_cognition_features_Agency: Gee, Sicart, Calleja-Kinesthetic — body/controller/rules-as-means. Pragmatism analog.
dissertation_game_studies_diagnostic.psychological_immersion_features_Agent: Salen & Zimmerman experiential frame; identity studies. Idealism analog.
dissertation_game_studies_diagnostic.platform_studies_features_Scene: Bogost, Murray platform constraints. Materialism analog.
dissertation_game_studies_diagnostic.gamification_critique_features_Purpose_p: Gamification rhetoric absolutizes 'engagement' or 'play' as pure-Purpose, which by Burke's paradox-of-purity flips into compulsion-loop critique. Mysticism analog at its critiqued limit-case.

meta.exceeds_plan_target: plan §3D.iv expected ≥30; delivered 35 with school-placement notes; some philosophers appear in multiple schools (cross-school placement)
